ja: • 大人気チョッパーロボに、新シリーズ登場！
• チョッパーの悪魔の実の能力をモチーフにした、かっこかわいいデザインだ！
• ２号は重力強化（ヘビーポイント）がモチーフ！
• 複数の関節で腕が多彩に可動！
• 続々登場する新シリーズ全部集めて組み換え・合体遊びを楽しもう！
• とってもかわいいチョッパーフィギュアも２体付くぞ！
en: • A new series of the popular Chopper Robo is now available!
• A cool and cute design based on Chopper's devil fruit abilities!
• The motif of No. 2 is gravity reinforcement (heavy points)!
• Arms can move in a variety of ways with multiple joints!
• Collect all the new series that are appearing one after another and enjoy recombining and combining!
• When all 5 are combined, they become arms!
• Also includes two super cute Chopper figures!
